brief:
Israeli forces opened heavy fire Thursday morning on shelter centers and displacement tents housing civilians in Jabalia camp, north Gaza, wounding several residents, Shehab Wire reported. The shooting represents a fresh breach of the ceasefire arrangement between the warring parties.

The strike targeted facilities sheltering displaced persons within the densely populated refugee camp in northern Gaza. The military operation came as international mediators continue efforts to maintain the truce. No additional information was immediately available regarding the total number of wounded or the severity of their injuries.
